description: Decode a Base64 data URI text file back into a real image file.

faq.question: How do I convert Base64 back to an image?
faq.answer: Upload a .txt file that contains exactly one data URI (data:image/png;base64,...), pick the target format, and download the image.

faq.question: Which inputs are accepted?
faq.answer: A single data:image/*;base64,... URI (JPEG, PNG, WebP, BMP, GIF or TIFF). Raw base64 without the data: header is rejected in this MVP.

faq.question: Is the output identical to the embedded image?
faq.answer: The payload is decoded, verified as a real image, and re-encoded to your chosen raster format. PNG targets stay lossless; JPEG targets re-encode at default quality.

faq.question: What is the size limit?
faq.answer: Decoded payloads up to 20 MiB are accepted; anything larger fails with an honest error instead of a truncated file.
